import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductCupCoordinates
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductSplitting
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyMayerVietorisCup

/-!
# The cup formula for the circle-product splitting

The connecting class of the first overlap component is a degree-one class on
`X × Circle`. Cupping this class with a first-factor pullback gives exactly the
shifted summand of the additive decomposition. Reversing the order introduces
the sign of the first-factor degree.

The class here is normalized by the ordered antipodal overlap. Identifying it
as pullback of a single normalized class on `Circle` is a separate naturality
statement. This is the cup calculation in the circle-product step of Mumford,
Chapter I, Section 1, integral cohomology.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The degree-one class obtained from the first component of the ordered
antipodal overlap by the actual Mayer--Vietoris connecting map. -/
def circleProductConnectingClass (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) 1 :=
  circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v 0 (singularCohomologyOne X, 0)

/-- The shifted summand is cup product by the connecting degree-one class
on the left, followed by pullback from the first factor. -/
theorem circleProductConnectingClass_cup_pullback (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (b : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    singularCohomologyCup (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) 1 n (n + 1) (by omega)
      (circleProductConnectingClass X v) (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n b) =
        circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v n (b, 0) := by
  have h := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup
    (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).1 (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.1
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.2 (Nat.zero_add n)
    ((circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v 0).symm (singularCohomologyOne X, 0))
    (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n b)
  rw [circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_first_component_cup] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- In first-factor-first order, the connecting summand has the sign of the
degree of the first-factor class. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyConnecting_eq_signed_cup (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (b : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v n (b, 0) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ n • singularCohomologyCup (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) n 1 (n + 1) rfl
        (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n b) (circleProductConnectingClass X v) := by
  have h := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_left
    (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).1 (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.1
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.2 n 0
    (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n b)
    ((circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v 0).symm (singularCohomologyOne X, 0))
  simp only [Nat.add_zero] at h
  rw [circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv_cup_first_component] at h
  exact h

/-- The actual additive circle-product equivalence has this cup-product
formula for its inverse. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyEquiv_symm_apply_cup (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X (n + 1))
    (b : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    (circleProductCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm (a, b) =
      circleProductCohomologyPullback X (n + 1) a +
        singularCohomologyCup (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) 1 n (n + 1) (by omega)
          (circleProductConnectingClass X v) (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n b) := by
  rw [circleProductCohomologyEquiv_symm_apply, circleProductConnectingClass_cup_pullback]

/-- Cupping a first-factor class with the connecting class gives exactly
the second coordinate of the circle-product equivalence. -/
@[simp]
theorem circleProductCohomologyEquiv_apply_cup (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (b : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    circleProductCohomologyEquiv X v n
      (singularCohomologyCup (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) 1 n (n + 1) (by omega)
        (circleProductConnectingClass X v) (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n b)) =
          (0, b) := by
  rw [circleProductConnectingClass_cup_pullback,
    circleProductCohomologyEquiv_apply_connecting, sub_zero]

end Mumford.Analytic
